name: strata-warm
description: Warm prompt-cache TTFT on one L40S: 1k/4k/16k/64k at C1 plus 1k/4k at C4, three repeats.
caveats: Cold cells were not rerun; the comparison to stored cold numbers is invalid because that probe was uncalibrated. Repeat 1 inside the same server is the apples-to-apples cold reference.
Warm mode sends saltless, byte-identical prompts; a C=1 cell can hit a checkpoint left by an earlier cell and that is reported, not hidden.
The conversation cache is 8 GiB / 4 parked conversations on the baseline recipe; larger contexts can evict.
The warm section lives in the 2026-10-25 smoke-matrix document (section "Warm vs cold cache"); the evidence dir also has NOTES.md and warm-vs-cold.csv.
